title: PROSOCIALDIALOG: A Prosocial Backbone for Conversational Agents
findings: Religion is included as a category of sensitive characteristics requiring prosocial responses and safety-aware handling (under the 'Needs Caution' label). However, the paper does not provide specific experimental results or findings broken down by religious content.
